annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive of 18 June 1986 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 84/529/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to electrically operated lifts (86/312/EEC)
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive of 18 June 1986 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 84/529/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to electrically operated lifts (86/312/EEC)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 196
annotation.summary_en: 1986 Commission Directive adapting Council Directive 84/529/EEC on electrically operated lifts to technical progress, replacing Annex I to reference standard EN 81-1 (December 1985 edition) with specified modifications. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex I of Directive 84/529/EEC replaced by new Annex
Lifts must comply with CEN standard EN 81-1 (Dec 1985) with modifications
Member States must transpose before 27 September 1986
Electrical installations must follow Cenelec harmonized documents or national rules
